request.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real material texture and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. No letters, words, numbers, logos or brand marks anywhere, not even on the pet's collar, bowl or bed. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen. Every visible hand has five natural fingers. Do not imitate earlier course photos.

Keep the person, the pet and the pet's thing inside the central 55 percent of the photo width, so a centered 4:5 crop keeps them whole; only expendable background reaches the left and right edges.

Only this one person and this one pet are in the photo; there is nobody else and no other animal, even far in the background.

The pet and what it does with its own thing are the most obvious part of the photo: the camera is at the pet's level a few steps away, the animal is a real, natural-looking animal with correct anatomy, and the person looks at the pet, not at the camera.

It is clearly daytime with soft natural light.

Image 1 shows Sofia. Keep her face, long curly dark hair, warm brown skin and build exactly, and her white blouse under her bright blue blazer, with no badge and no card. Create a new photograph in her bright living room in the daytime: Sofia sits at the end of a light sofa and smiles down at her cat. On the floor right beside the sofa is the cat's own bed, a round soft grey cat bed with a raised rim; a grey-and-white cat lies in it, awake and calm, clearly ON its bed. The cat in its bed is large, near the camera and in sharp focus, and Sofia's face is fully visible in three-quarter view. A window with daylight and a small plant are softly visible behind them.

cost.basis: Reported usage at list prices checked 2026-11-16; before tax, not an invoice.
